paragraphs: The Defender D200 is part of the modern L663 generation, introduced in 2019. It uses the Ingenium AJ200D, a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel engine, which in the D200 is paired with a mild-hybrid (MHEV) system. This engine family is used across the wider JLR range and has known patterns around timing chain wear and, for MHEV variants like the D200, DC-DC converter failure. Knowing these specifics matters, because the components, the known wear pattern, and the rebuild specifics differ from the non-MHEV petrol models. Land Rover Defender D200 Engine Codes AJ200D (D200) A 2.0-litre 4-cylinder diesel fitted to the Defender D200 from 2019. This is an Ingenium diesel with a mild-hybrid system. Known for the Ingenium timing chain pattern and DC-DC converter failure pattern — see the callout above. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, and service the DC-DC converter as standard where applicable. Check Your AJ200D Defender D200 → [link to quote form] Land Rover Defender D200 Engine Compatibility Because the D200 uses the AJ200D which is shared with the D240, and the petrol P300 shares the same base engine without the MHEV system, correct identification is critical. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm: - Your exact engine code (AJ200D) - Your generation (L663) - Drivetrain and ancillary specification, particularly the MHEV components - Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic Defender D200 quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car. Rebuilds start from £2,200. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote. Which engine code is fitted to my Defender D200? Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the AJ200D before you're quoted anything. Do you rebuild AJ200D Defender D200 engines? Yes. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR, gaskets, and service the DC-DC converter as standard on every AJ200D rebuild. Do you supply used Defender D200 engines? Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation. Can you recover my Defender D200 if the engine has failed? Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking. How long does a Defender D200 engine rebuild take? Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop. Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine? For most Defender D200 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers. cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Defender D200 from 2023 to present. The engine features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older engine V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every engine rebuild.
